obsidian._review_auto: v0.45 (KAN-86): the weekly review is written to review_folder by itself once per week, after Friday review_auto_hour (or on the next page load if no page was open then; up to 3 weeks back). Create-only; Save in the Weekly review view still works by hand.
obsidian._write_note: New notes (v0.37) are created only, never overwritten, in write_folders or, when that is empty, in the folders above (and their subfolders). note_folder / meeting_folder / review_folder are the defaults; empty = note_folder. templates_folder: its .md files appear as templates ({{title}}, {{date}}, {{time}}).
obsidian._capture: Quick capture appends one line: text to capture_text_file, tasks (- [ ]) to capture_task_file (v0.44); capture_file is the old single file, used only when those are empty; <capture_daily_folder>/YYYY-MM-DD.md takes both when set; the folder must be one the dashboard may write to. Inbox triage moves notes out of inbox_folder only. watch_seconds: how often the server checks the Obsidian folders for hand edits and re-reads them (0 = only with the full harvest).

jira._note: project and issue_type are used by New Jira issue; default_epic (e.g. KAN-29) is the Epic every new issue starts with, empty = none. jql empty = open issues of the project plus Done in the last 14 days.

stats._note: Example rules. Copy to config.json and adapt. Rules are tried top to bottom, first match wins, case-insensitive regex on the event title. 'Absence' marks time off, 'Ignore' is not counted. out_of_office_as: a work event Exchange marks 'out of office' is an off-site day and goes to that group, except the listed groups. supergroups: categories per group (Uncategorized is not grouped).

category_map._note: v0.67 (KAN-105): Outlook category -> Statistics category (a group name from the rules above, or Absence / Ignore). Read from Outlook for the planner.outlook_calendar; a [Tag] in the title still wins, then this map, then the title rules. Empty = title rules only, Outlook is not asked.

planner._note: Plan blocks (P). calendar: name of the EventKit calendar picked by default; empty = the Exchange 'Calendar'. buffer_minutes: kept free next to meetings. outlook: book blocks in the Outlook calendar through Microsoft Outlook, so a category can be set (EventKit cannot). outlook_account: empty = the first Exchange account. outlook_calendar: the calendar name in Outlook. outlook_categories: the categories to offer, in this order; empty = every category Outlook knows (including its built-in ones).

weather._note: Weather in the greeting, from Open-Meteo (free, no key). Only these coordinates are sent; fetched at most every 30 min. enabled false turns it off.
